title: Rural-urban components and urbanisation
quote: 2001-11: first time since Independence urban India added more people than rural India

boxes.title: Components of urban growth
steps: ==**Rural-to-urban migration**== - explains most of the gap

boxes.title: Drivers
head: Factor
Examples
rows: Industrialisation, jobs, trade, health & education, transport
Failed monsoon → rural unemployment; poverty, landlessness

boxes.title: Regional pattern
head: Level
Regions / states
rows: ==**South & west**==: Goa, TN, Kerala, Maharashtra, Gujarat; NE exception **Mizoram**
**East & NE**: Bihar, Assam, Odisha; also HP
Middle/lower Ganga plains, Telangana, western Rajasthan, NE hills

boxes.title: Current estimates
items: EAC-PM satellite data: ==**63%**== in **2015** vs Census **31%**
Budget 2026-27: **₹5,000 crore** per City Economic Region

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Census towns jump → reclassification a major component
Migration, not natural increase, explains rural-urban gap
Binary rural-urban definition leaves urbanising areas under panchayats
